recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Further source edits would be redundant unless a future Patient Care decision changes the CarePlan activity status taxonomy.
issue_request: FHIR-12623 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care change request for the DSTU2 CarePlan artifact. It asked to add a new stopped code under cancelled in the CarePlan activity status value set/code system, to clarify cancelled as withdrawn, completed as completed more or less as planned, and unknown as not a substitute for other.
initial_application: Git commit 1afa3503ac4fcef5a2d591f73dc5a1a143a1da25 explicitly referenced #12623 and updated the historical CarePlan spreadsheet to add stopped beneath cancelled, update the CarePlan status short list, and revise the completed, cancelled, and unknown definitions.
additional_context: CarePlan is active in source/fhir.ini and CarePlanActivityStatus is registered in source/bindings.ini. Current source carries the relevant CodeSystem and ValueSet under source/careplan. Bounded Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches did not find a later in-scope reversal or conflicting Patient Care decision; the only neighboring Jira hit was FHIR-25267, a Triaged CareTeam issue outside this CarePlan status decision.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. source/careplan/codesystem-care-plan-activity-status.xml declares hierarchyMeaning=is-a, has cancelled as the parent concept, has stopped as its child, and preserves the requested completed, cancelled, stopped, and unknown semantics. source/careplan/structuredefinition-CarePlan.xml includes stopped in the activity status short list and binds the status element to the complete CarePlan activity status value set.

related_jiras.note: Jira search surfaced this Triaged CareTeam participant status issue, but it concerns a different artifact and is not a final CarePlan activity status decision.
